places.name: Mackinac Island
places.ai_summary: A charming island known for its historic sites, horse-drawn carriages, and fudge shops.
places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the island’s scenic trails.
places.address: Mackinac Island, Michigan, USA

places.name: Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore
places.ai_summary: A stunning natural area featuring towering sand dunes, beaches, and hiking trails along Lake Michigan.
places.place_tip: Climb the dunes for breathtaking views of Lake Michigan.
places.address: Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore, Michigan, USA

places.name: Detroit Institute of Arts
places.ai_summary: A world-class art museum featuring over 65,000 works, including Diego Rivera’s famous murals.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Rivera Court murals, a highlight of the museum.
places.address: 5200 Woodward Ave, Detroit, Michigan, USA

places.name: Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore
places.ai_summary: Famous for its colorful sandstone cliffs, this national lakeshore offers stunning views and outdoor activities.
places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to see the cliffs from the water.
places.address: Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore, Michigan, USA

places.ai_summary: A large indoor and outdoor history museum complex in Dearborn, Michigan, dedicated to American innovation.

places.name: Isle Royale National Park
places.ai_summary: A remote island park known for its wilderness, wildlife, and the historic Rock Harbor Lighthouse.
places.place_tip: Bring your own food and supplies, as amenities are limited.
places.address: Isle Royale National Park, Michigan, USA

places.name: Holland State Park
places.ai_summary: A popular state park with a sandy beach, picnic areas, and views of Lake Michigan and the Big Red Lighthouse.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal access to the lighthouse.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Holland Harbor Lighthouse, also known as Big Red.
places.address: 2215 Ottawa Beach Rd, Holland, Michigan, USA

places.ai_summary: Home to one of the largest waterfalls east of the Mississippi, this park offers stunning natural beauty.
places.place_tip: Try the local fish fry at the park’s restaurant.
